input_narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic remote monitoring center reported that the patient suffered a confirmed embolic stroke temporally linked to an unflagged rapid-ventricular-response atrial fibrillation episode, confirmed by hospital emergency response records.
